Q: How can I copy files from a host to a Docker container? A:

I tried most of the (upvoted) solutions here, but in Docker 17.09 (in 2018) there isn't a /var/lib/docker/aufs folder any longer.

This simple docker cp solved this task.

docker cp c:\path\to\local\file container_name:/path/to/target/dir/

How can we get container_name?

docker ps

There is a NAMES section. Don't use an IMAGE.

Q: Workflow Validation Error - unable to query Oracle Database Using Service Provider Connector From Azure Logic App A:

As written your mentioned Microsoft docs, "Operation ID: rawQuery" not executeQuery

Q: APL Optical Character Recognition A:

You can train tesseract to recognize custom characters: Python 3 OCR with custom characters

I don't think any generic service or software is likely to do a good job with APL.
